profileCompleteness.statement: This source-grounded register covers the R7 ontology and known PRE-RICH/V3 components, but does not prove that they exhaust all economic content the profile can create.
closureBlockers: PA2: no authoritative exhaustive enumeration of all profile assets/commitments mapped exactly once.
PA3: no complete A4↔L3 pairing/disjointness proof.
PA4: no complete valuation function for each applicable cell, including Ω-worst-case L3.
PA5/PA6: no proof every operation preserves permitted deltas and L6 is empty.
PA7: no independent adversarial omission review.
EV1-EV7 and P1-P8: no authenticated deployment EEV and complete authoritative perimeter package.
NV1-NV5: no authenticated live S0 evidence.
